text:
alex_sales: Heads up 1 HealthCo (large healthcare customer) asked to run a hands-on POC next week. Requirements they listed: SOC2 artefact extracts, an authorization to run vulnerability scans against the POC endpoints, and temporary staging credentials. They also want clarity on whether this will trigger Dedicated/reserved pricing. Need owners and a short runbook.

rachel_se: Quick checklist 1) Where will the POC run (their VPC vs our isolated tenant)? 2) Exact scan scope and allowed IPs. 3) Evidence bundle contents and delivery method (they prefer SFTP). I can own coordination with the buyer.

mira_security: We can provide: a SOC2 summary + control matrix excerpt, a redacted ISO section, and a signed scan-authorization template. Important: we do NOT permit scans against production multi-tenant endpoints. If they want a single-tenant environment we can authorize scoped scans. Also need to confirm whether PHI will be in scope.

alex_sales: Customer replied: wants the POC in our staging single-tenant instance (not prod), will not include PHI, and requested scanning window Thu-Fri next week. Contact is fred.kim@healthco.com (security lead). They said theyll share scanner IPs today.

tyler_devops: Infra notes: we can spin up a time-limited private deployment and provide ephemeral API key + ephemeral host IPs. Options: 
```
- hosted isolated tenant (fast, no VPC peering) -> ~24h
- VPC peering into customer VPC -> ~3-5 business days
```
If they choose hosted isolated tenant it is normally billed as hosted with no reserved commit for short trials (<14 days). If they request a dedicated reserved pool or sustained capacity we need to move to Dedicated pricing.

jordan_sales: Pricing context: for a <2 week demo we typically keep it on trial/hosted. If they insist on single-tenant reserved pool for network isolation that may trigger a small monthly reservation (min term applies). I can prepare two quotes: (A) hosted ephemeral demo with no commit (B) 1-month small reserved pool.

mira_security: To proceed with the scan permission we need three items from HealthCo: (1) scan IP list, (2) allowed endpoints + methods (e.g., GET /api/v1/*, ws/stream), (3) planned time window. I'll draft an authorization letter once they confirm. Also will add a short residency and logging statement (POC logs retained 72h, no PHI persisted).

rachel_se: please include an example template for the customer to sign so procurement is happy. Also we need to be explicit about non-destructive scans only and rate-limiting.

mira_security: draft snippet (will upload full signed PDF to secure SFTP):
```
Redwood Inference grants HealthCo security team permission to perform non-destructive vulnerability scans against the provisioned POC endpoints hosted in Redwood's isolated staging environment. Permitted targets: /api/v1/* and streaming endpoints. Scans must be pre-scheduled, limited to the approved IP addresses provided to Redwood, and limited to the agreed time window. Redwood will provide ephemeral credentials and diagnostic logs for the test period. This authorization does not apply to Redwood production multi-tenant systems.
```

evidence-bot: Reminder: upload artifact bundles to secure location sftp.redwood-internal.com/proofs/healthco_poc. Pre-signed link will expire in 48 hours. Request ticket #POC-4821 for upload.

tyler_devops: Actionable infra items: once we have IPs I can provision isolated tenant + ephemeral API key within 12-24h. If customer requests peering we need network diagram and CIDR details (add 3-5 business days).

jordan_sales: I'll post two-line pricing bullets in the thread EOD: ephemeral-hosted demo (no commit) vs 1-month reserved small pool. Also include optional assisted SFTP upload / test-support day-rate.

alex_sales: Action owners recap: 
- get scanner IPs + signed SOW by EOD (alex_sales / HealthCo)
- security to prepare signed scan-authorization + SOC2 extract (mira_security)
- infra to standby for ephemeral tenant provisioning (tyler_devops)
- pricing quote for hosted vs reserved (jordan_sales)
- upload artifacts to SFTP when ready (evidence-bot / mira_security)

alex_sales: pinged fred.kim for IPs and signed SOW. asked for confirmation theyll avoid PHI and agreed non-destructive scans only.

rachel_se: ack, I'll coordinate a single calendar slot once we have confirmation.

mira_security: ack, drafting the signed letter now and will route for signature as soon as HealthCo confirms IPs.

tyler_devops: ack, standing by for IPs to provision.

jordan_sales: ack, will post quote by EOD PST.

alex_sales: thanks all 1 tagging to close loop when uploads/permission signed so we can lock the test window. :white_check_mark:
